# v2.3.0 — God-File Decomposition (R-GOD, CI-49–CI-51)

Released: 2026-05-26

## Refactored
- `R-GOD`: Complete decomposition of `api/app.py` from 1,005 lines → 47-line factory shell across 10 extraction steps (S1–S10), each verified by a standalone smoke test.

  **New modules extracted:**
  | Module | Contents | Step |
  |---|---|---|
  | `api/config.py` | env vars, algorithm guard, slowapi limiter, oauth2_scheme | S1 |
  | `api/stub_users.py` | dev/test `_USERS` store + env guard | S2 |
  | `api/schemas.py` | `Token`, `TokenPayload`, `IncidentCreate`, `StatusUpdate`, `IncidentUpdate` | S3 |
  | `src/auth/tokens.py` | `create_access_token`, `create_refresh_token`, `decode_token`; jti + ttl returned | S4 |
  | `api/dependencies.py` | `authenticate_user`, `get_current_user`, `require_role`, `get_user_repo`, `get_denylist` | S5 |
  | `api/lifespan.py` | `@asynccontextmanager lifespan`; DB, Redis, RS256, OTel bootstrap | S6 |
  | `api/routers/health.py` | `GET /health`, `GET /ready` | S7 |
  | `api/routers/auth.py` | `POST /auth/token`, `/auth/refresh`, `/auth/logout` (rate-limited 5/min) | S8 |
  | `api/routers/incidents.py` | Full incidents CRUD + status PATCH; R-C07 TOCTOU fix | S9 |
  | `api/middleware.py` | `trace_and_security_headers` middleware | S10 |

  **Architecture items unlocked:**
  - **R-C03**: `_denylist`/`_user_repo` shared-state race — now isolated in `api/dependencies.py`
  - **R-C04**: `_build_engine()` no longer called at import time
  - **R-CI02**: Clean `api.app:app` Gunicorn/Uvicorn entry point

## Added
- `CI-49`: Observability coverage tests for `logging_config` and `otel_setup`; closes coverage gap on OTel bootstrap and structured log scrubbing paths.
- `CI-51`: SLSA provenance attestation for SBOM artifact via `actions/attest-build-provenance`.

## Fixed
- `CI-50`: Add missing test files + coverage scopes to unit-tests CI job; `--cov-fail-under` raised `68` → `75`.
- Patch chain `2.3.3`–`2.3.6`: Codacy false positive suppressions, gitleaks token replacement, `InvalidTransitionError` re-raise ordering, stale import path fix.
